title: David Cia Earns 3rd Place at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids No-Gi Championship
desc: Cristyan Jiu-Jitsu & Fitness student David Cia earned third place at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids No-Gi Championship and reached the quarterfinals in the Gi division.

David Cia Earns 3rd Place at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids No-Gi Championship

October 25, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Cristyan Jiu-Jitsu & Fitness was proudly represented by one student at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids Jiu-Jitsu No-Gi Championship: David Cia, who earned third place.

Competing on a major stage takes preparation, focus, and courage. David's podium finish reflects the hard work he has put in on the mats, and our team is proud of his effort and achievement. Congratulations, David!

David Cia's Pan Kids results

No-Gi: 3rd place at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids No-Gi Championship

Gi: Reached the quarterfinals at the 2026 IBJJF Pan Kids Gi Championship

David competed in both formats and represented Cristyan Jiu-Jitsu & Fitness with determination. Every match is an opportunity to learn, grow, and keep moving forward.

Building confidence through competition

At Cristyan Jiu-Jitsu & Fitness, our kids' program helps students develop skill, discipline, confidence, and respect. Students interested in tournament training can also learn about our Kids BJJ Competition Class.

Congratulations again to David Cia on earning third place in No-Gi and representing our academy. We're proud of you!

Interested in kids' Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Hyannis? Explore our Kids BJJ program and class schedule, or get started with a trial class.
